distractors.reason: We don't say 'eat the animals' with this meaning. 'Eat' is used when a person or animal consumes food: eat breakfast, eat grass.
We don't say 'drink the animals'. 'Drink' is used with liquids: drink water, drink milk.
We don't say 'cook the animals' when we mean giving them food. 'Cook' means preparing food with heat, which is not what we do for pets.

example_sentence: Every morning I ___ the animals on the farm.
l1_interference: Українці можуть сказати 'eat the animals', бо 'їсти' і 'годувати' часто плутаються. Правильна англійська фраза — 'feed the animals'.
explanation: 'Feed' means giving food to animals or people who cannot feed themselves. It is the standard verb for pets and farm animals.

related_collocations.example: Please feed the dog before you go to school.
I walk the dog every evening in the park.
We clean the cage of our hamster on Sundays.

memory_tip: FEED = give food to animals or people | EAT = put food into your own mouth
